name: luna-worker-planner
description: Plan and govern projects while delegating work to luna_worker and critically evaluating its evidence and conclusions.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, delegate, and critically evaluate results.
interface.longDescription: Use this conversation as the project planner and controller. It delegates project work to luna_worker, critically reasons over the returned evidence without independently inspecting the project, delegates any needed fact-checking, and then makes its own project decisions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Luna Worker Planner to delegate project work to luna_worker, reason critically over its report without redoing the inspection, delegate any needed fact-checking, and make an independent planning decision.
